source_evidence: Rising interest rates will make newly issued bonds more appealing to investors because the newer bonds will have a higher rate of interest than older ones. To sell an older bond with a lower interest rate, you might have to sell it at a discount.
question: Why might an older bond sell for less than its face value when interest rates rise?
answer: Newly issued bonds may offer higher interest than the older bond, making them more appealing to buyers. To sell the older bond before it matures, you might need to offer it at a discount.
